missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Ночь' is a feminine soft-sign noun standing in the nominative as the subject. 'Тихая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'очень' intensifies the description.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Ночь' is the accusative direct object of 'люблю'; feminine soft-sign nouns keep the same form in the accusative singular. 'Тихую' is the agreeing feminine accusative adjective.

missions.phrase: Я не спал до поздней ночи.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Ночи' is the genitive form of 'ночь' after 'до', marking the time up to which the action lasted. 'Поздней' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of time. 'Ночью' is the instrumental form used adverbially to mean 'at night', a fixed time expression. 'Холодно' is the impersonal predicate describing the cold.
Strategic focus: Accusative of duration. 'Ночь' is the accusative expressing how long we walked. 'Всю' agrees in the feminine accusative, and 'напролёт' stresses the whole night through.

Strategic focus: Genitive in a wish. 'Ночи' is genitive, governed by the verb 'желаю' which takes the genitive of the thing wished. 'Спокойной' agrees in the feminine genitive. A standard goodnight phrase.

Strategic focus: Instrumental of time in a question. 'Ночью' again uses the instrumental adverbially to mean 'during the night'. 'Что было' frames the question about events. A natural conversational pattern.

Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Ночи' is the dative form after 'к', marking the time toward which things changed. 'Стало темно' is the impersonal predicate describing the falling darkness.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Ночи' is the nominative plural subject. 'Зимние' and 'длинные' are agreeing plural adjectives, and 'очень' intensifies. A clean example of the soft-sign plural.

missions.phrase: Я часто думаю о той ночи.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Ночи' is the prepositional form after 'о', expressing the night thought about. 'Той' agrees in the feminine prepositional, and 'часто' adds frequency.
